|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, when deployed, may retrieve up to two Imperials (or one into hand). While present at a site you control, Effects with 'Celebration' in title at related system are suspended and, once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a trooper.
|errata_history=This card has one published text. The Virtual Block slip and the Players Committee card image shown here print it.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011), page 2, slip 7 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>; the slip ([[:File:VB7-03-ISB_Sector_Commander.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-isbsectorcommander-pre.gif]]) print it; the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 9)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9, page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text. The PC website card list<ref name="cl-1273_7">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VMasterType list) (Internet Archive)</ref> shows the same card with the card list's usual notation: it writes the pilot icon out as “Adds 2 to the power of any starship he pilots” and the ▼ as plain “deploy a trooper”; that is not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). It also writes “use 1 force” (lower case) — capitals only, held for the wiki owner's ruling.
